artworks.title: A White Line Border with Two Cartouches: "A Satyr Sacrificing a Ram," and "The Choice of Hercules"
artworks.medium: woodcut page removed from a book
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornately decorated page from an old manuscript. The description details a highly intricate and decorative border featuring a combination of floral and mythical motifs surrounding the text. The text itself is in Latin, and the font style is reminiscent of medieval script. The borders on either side of the page showcase elaborate patterns with alternating botanical and symbolic designs. At the top center, there is a representation of a heraldic figure or emblem, and at the bottom, a detailed scene depicts figures engaged in a scholarly or ecclesiastical discourse. The overall composition evokes an antique aesthetic, typical of medieval or Renaissance manuscripts.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.artist: Johann Jakob Thourneysen, after Joachim von Sandrart I, after the Antique
artworks.description: The image shows a classical-style engraving of a person reclining in a cave-like environment. The person is seated on the ground with one arm resting on their knee and the other hand extending towards the ground. Their head is tilted downwards with soft facial features and medium-length, curly hair. They are draped in a loose-fitting garment, partially exposing their upper torso. Behind them is a large, ornate urn or pot. The background consists of a textured, cave-like wall.

artworks.title: Giant Oak with a Seated Fisherman
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 29.8 × 40.2 cm (11 3/4 × 15 13/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a detailed tree on the right side and a figure with a fishing rod near its base. In the background, there is a river, an arched bridge, and lush vegetation. The illustration is done in fine etching, featuring intricate details and a monochromatic color palette of gray and black emphasizing texture and depth.

artworks.title: Bacchanal with Altar, Faun, and Silenus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with multiple figures and ornate architecture. The scene depicts figures gathered around a richly decorated structure with intricate reliefs. Cherub-like children play among the adults, who are engaged in various activities, including raising hands and holding objects. The architecture and figures suggest a historical or mythological theme, with detailed ornamentation conveying an air of opulence and classical antiquity. Shadows and lines are used to convey depth and detail, enhancing the setting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Fireman
artworks.creditLine: Mary and Dan Solomon Fund and Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, angled slightly to the left. He looks at the camera with a stern expression. He has a short beard, mustache, and dark hair partially covered by a tall hat decorated with the number "41." He wears a red, striped coat, a black bow tie, and a white handkerchief in his coat's pocket. The background is nondescript, and the image is enclosed in a golden-framed border, suggesting it is an old photograph, possibly a daguerreotype.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman and Baby
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman visible from the waist up, holding a baby in her lap. She is positioned straightforward, facing the camera. The woman has dark skin, a defined nose, and styled back hair. Her clothing is a patterned dress with a high collar and a small embellishment. The baby is dressed in a light-colored gown. The woman wears a small necklace or pendant around her neck. The background includes a decorative chair, and the photograph is framed in an elegant, gold-patterned frame.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, leaning in an open window frame of an old brick building with wooden panels. He has one leg bent and resting on the window ledge, with his arms crossed in front of him holding a small object resembling a bowler hat. The man has a slender face with prominent cheekbones, a faint smile, and medium-length hair combed back. He is wearing a dark suit with a long coat, waistcoat, and bow tie, over a light-colored shirt. Climbing plants are visible on the brick wall, and the partly open window reveals a dimly lit interior.

artworks.title: The Death of Property Tax!!!
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with publisher's hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a political cartoon depicting a group of individuals battling a multi-headed green monster labeled as "Propertaxus", symbolizing a property tax. Two characters are attacking the monster with a document labeled "Repeal of the Property Tax". A lion labeled "Leo Britannicus" is biting one of the monster's heads, while a woman holding a shield with the Union Jack lies nearby. In the background, figures are retreating towards a cave labeled "Economy", with speech bubbles filling the sky. The cartoon uses exaggerated imagery and labels to critique taxation policy.

artworks.title: A New Way to Pay the National-Debt
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene involving money and finance. It shows elaborately dressed figures engaging in the exchange of large sacks. In the background, there is a stone archway labeled "TREASURY" and various notices or documents posted on the walls. One individual is kneeling or sitting on the ground, while others are in extravagant attire.

artworks.title: Modern Grace
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with publisher's hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a dance scene with exaggerated costumes and movements. The image features three figures in colorful attire dancing against a stylized background depicting a bright sun. The central figure is energetically posed on one leg, while the two figures on either side match the dynamic energy. Two additional figures appear in motion in the background, contributing to the lively atmosphere of the scene. This is in the style of James Gillray.

artworks.title: Titianus Redivivus
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and aquatint with publisher's hand-coloring, on laid paper

artworks.title: A Winged Skeleton Holding an Anatomical Drawing
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a print of a skeleton with wings, seated on a table. The skeleton appears to be holding or unfurling a large sheet of paper or cloth, on which is drawn the outline of a muscular human. The composition is set in a stark room with shadows cast by a strong, unseen light source, that casts a circle of light around the skeleton. On the table beside the skeleton and beneath it is a collection of skulls and bones.

artworks.title: Desaix
artworks.artist: Pierre-Charles Coqueret, after Hilaire Le Dru
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in rough waters, appearing to step from a boat onto a rocky shore. The man has shoulder-length, curly light-colored hair and is dressed in a dark robe with embroidery, a sash, and knee-high boots. He holds a large sword by his side. In the background, stormy skies with lightning, ships, and crashing waves are depicted.

artworks.title: Very unpleasant weather
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with publisher's hand coloring
artworks.description: This is a print of a scene where cats, dogs, and pitchforks are falling from the sky like rain. On the street below, people dressed in colorful clothing attempt to shelter under umbrellas. Some of the people lay on the ground, impaled by pitchforks. Two people sit in a golden carriage, looking out at the chaos. The faces of the people in the print are exaggerated and cartoonish. The background includes several large red buildings in front of green hills and a blue sky.

artworks.title: Forest Clearing with an Oak Trunk
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with hills, trees, a fallen tree trunk, foliage, two figures, and a dog. The scene is depicted with fine lines, cross-hatching for shading, and a monochromatic color palette of black and white.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Tree Trunk
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with detailed vegetation, including large leaves and foliage in the foreground. An old tree stump is situated among the plants. In the background, there are hills with scattered trees. The sky is clear with few clouds. The monochrome illustration uses fine lines and cross-hatching to depict textures and depth, especially in the leaves, tree stump, and background elements.

artworks.title: Hilly Forest View with a Fern
artworks.description: The image features a detailed view of a natural scene from an eye-level perspective. The horizon is not distinctly visible, as the composition is primarily filled with plants and rocky elements. In the middle of the image, a large, textured rock is surrounded by lush fern leaves, which dominate the space closest to us. The brushstrokes and etchings are meticulous, capturing the intricate details of the foliage and the rock's surface. The color palette is monochromatic, utilizing shades of black and white to convey depth and contrast, which accentuates the visual impact of the fern leaves and the ruggedness of the rock. In the background, faint outlines of trees add a subtle context of a forested area.

artworks.title: Wetland Plants
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of large leaves on rocky ground. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, revealing intricate details of the plants. There are shrubs and trees in the background with no structures. The style features detailed linework for a realistic depiction. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey, black, and white enhancing the texture. The scene includes lush vegetation, rocks, a mushroom, and a hovering butterfly.

artworks.title: Title Page to Vier Nachtstücke
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an oval emblem with text and decorative swirls. The centerpiece of the image is an oval shape containing calligraphic text and ornamental designs on either side of the text. The main text reads "Nachtstücke auf Kupfer radirt von C. Lebschée Landschaft-Maler." The lower part of the oval contains the publisher’s details, "Verlag der J. M. Hermann’schen Kunsthandlung in München." The design is symmetrically balanced with flourishing curves that frame the text within the oval.

artworks.title: Surging Waves
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with stormy waves crashing against a rocky outcrop. The horizon is high in the scene. The artwork is in black and white with detailed line work, resembling an engraving. The waves and clouds are depicted with swirling patterns, creating a sense of movement. The monochromatic palette enhances the play of light and shadow, giving a powerful presence to the scene.

artworks.title: Night-Time Boat Ride
artworks.description: The image shows a river or canal scene with a high horizon. The sky is filled with textured clouds, suggesting a calm evening atmosphere. A small boat with a figure on it is in the foreground. There is a narrow bridge over the water and trees with sparse foliage. The intricate brushwork captures fine light and shadow gradations in a monochromatic palette of black and gray.

artworks.title: Nocturnal Landscape
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape in black and white, capturing trees, a stream, and the horizon from a distant viewpoint. The sky is filled with clouds, and two large trees stand prominently in the center. A path or stream winds through the scene, leading to a small structure near fields or clearings. The artwork features detailed engravings with a monochromatic palette emphasizing contrast and detail.

artworks.title: Five Travellers in the Moonlight
artworks.description: The image depicts a nocturnal landscape with a group of individuals walking along a winding path. There is a low horizon with a bright, full moon partially obscured by clouds. Moonlight illuminates the scene, creating contrasts and shadows. The brushwork is detailed, capturing the texture of the foliage and clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray. In the distance, the moonlight reflects off the path, framed by trees with branches appearing to bend in the wind.

artworks.title: Embarcadere à Trouville (Wharf at Trouville)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on japan paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy dockside scene with a steamship, a figure on the shore, and several people near the ship. The background shows a distant structure, and the sky blends into subtle tones. The artwork is created using fine lines and cross-hatching typical of etching, using a monochrome color palette of black and grey.
